bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears kicked off their 2026 season with a thrilling 59-37 victory over the Carolina Panthers, in what became the highest-scoring Week 1 game in NFL history . Caleb Williams threw for two touchdowns and ran for two more, while D'Andre Swift scored three touchdown runs and rushed for 124 yards on 18 carries for Chicago , and remarkably, the final score marked the first time in league history that a game has ended with that exact score, a scorigami in Week 1 .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions kicked off their 2026 season with a thrilling 31-30 overtime victory over the New Orleans Saints at Ford Field on September 13. Tim Twentyman covers all the news from the Detroit Lions' 31-30 OT victory over the New Orleans Saints , though the win was clouded by injury concerns as Mahogany was ruled out for the rest of the game against the Saints after going down with a knee injury in the first half .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers opened their 2026 season on the road against the Minnesota Vikings, with quarterback Jordan Love throwing for two touchdowns and wide receiver Christian Watson posting a 147-yard, two-touchdown performance in the game. The Packers were in control late in the third quarter, but a late gamble backfired, and the Vikings piled on late to stun their NFC North rivals.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings pulled off a Week 1 victory over the Green Bay Packers after Carson Wentz stepped in for an injured Kyler Murray, with Carson Wentz leading the Minnesota Vikings to a win over the Green Bay Packers, potentially cementing himself as QB1 going forward. Justin Jefferson also had a strong showing, as he tested the Packers' cornerback rotation while creating openings for Jordan Addison and Jauan Jennings.
